correctness.rationale: For R = F_q[y]/(y^n), realize the presented algebra on R ⊕ xR with the stated twisted product; this establishes the normal form and not merely spanning. With δ(h)=h(λy)−h(y), the commutator has image x(δ(f)R + gδ(R)). The first ideal is y^sR, including zero at s=n. Modulo this ideal, multiplication by the unit part of g preserves independence of the distinct monomials indexed by i+t<s and d not dividing i. This gives n−s+H_d(s−t−1), also at g=0 and d=1. Independently choosing coefficients gives the two weights, and rank-nullity gives q^(2n−r) partners. In the nonresonant case the image becomes y^min(s,t+1)R and taking differences of the tail counts q^(2(n−m+1)) gives the displayed histogram. The center and the n=3,d=2 checks also follow. The frozen verification was inspected, not executed. Fresh exhaustive basis multiplication and elimination over F_5, n=3, checked 15,625 elements for each of d=2 and d=4; rank counts were (125,3000,12500) and (25,600,15000), respectively. This is finite corroboration; the algebraic argument supplies the universal proof.
residual_risks: The fresh exhaustive computation is limited to n=3 over F_5; the proof, not this run, covers extensions, characteristic two and unbounded n.
